text: 琏升科技公告，公司此前推进向特定对象发行股票事项，2026年9月23日收到深交所上市审核中心审核中心意见告知函，相关申请获审核通过，后续将按规定报中国证监会履行相关注册程序。
text_en: Liansheng Technology announced that the company had previously advanced a matter of issuing shares to specific targets. On September 23, 2026, it received a notice of opinion from the review center of the Shenzhen Stock Exchange Listing Review Center, and the relevant application passed review. Subsequently, it will, in accordance with regulations, submit the matter to the China Securities Regulatory Commission for relevant registration procedures.
